name: CAP Crest (embroidered eagle over shield with triangle and prop, scroll)
size_basis: Proportions measured from the CAP Crest and CAP Command Patch illustrations in CAPR 39-1 Fig A6-4 (the figure is undimensioned); height 2.8 in = the crest measured in CAPR 39-1 Figs 4.14/4.15 against the 3 3/8 in nametag plate (about 2.6 in in Fig 4.14, 3.0 in in Fig 4.15); the figures carry no scale of their own.
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h}; all in user units (0.01 in), origin top-left
documented: CAP Crest attached or sewn to the centre of the left breast pocket (CAPR 39-1 4.2.3.1.1.1)
assumed: hand-redrawn eagle, traced triangle and prop from the Command Patch
